journal.text: First session, $50k start, no committed history. Built a diversified initial portfolio using prior-session closes (snapshot + 30-40d OHLCV): core mega-cap tech (MSFT 6k, GOOGL 4k, AMZN 4k, META 3k, AAPL 2k), AI/semis tilt (NVDA 5k, AVGO 2.5k, AMD 2k - strongest June momentum, NVDA near highs after May breakout), defensives (COST 2.5k, WMT 2k, LIN 2k, AEP 1.5k, ORLY 1.5k), healthcare (ISRG 2k - bounced off early-June gap-down and recovering; VRTX 1.5k - flat range), consumer/media (NFLX 1.5k - strong uptrend at highs), energy (FANG 1k - pulled back from mid-June high, counter-cyclical diversifier), power/AI infrastructure (CEG 1k), TXN 1k for semi diversification. Total deployed ~$46k, ~$4k (8%) cash buffer to absorb unknown opening gaps. Notional dollar orders so fills cannot fail on overnight price moves. Reconsider: trim or stop-add if NVDA/AMD/AVGO momentum breaks (close below ~20-day trend), add to ISRG if recovery continues, rebalance monthly after the Aug 1 deposit; deploy remaining cash on a broad pullback or after a few sessions of confirmed trend.
